bool text_less(string a, string b)
    int[] first := a.codepoints()
    int[] second := b.codepoints()
    count := if #first < #second then #first else #second
    for: i < count
        if first[i] != second[i]
            return first[i] < second[i]
    return #first < #second

bool has_word(string[] words, string word)
    for item := words[]
        if item == word
            return true
    return false

bool has_number(int[] numbers, int number)
    for item := numbers[]
        if item == number
            return true
    return false

nat find_at(string text, string needle)
    match text.find(needle)
        nat found
            return found
        none
            return #text

string lower(string text)
    result := ""
    for: i < #text
        at := find_at("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", text[i])
        result += if at < 26 then "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[at] else text[i]
    return result

bool all_chars(string text, string alphabet)
    for: i < #text
        if not alphabet.contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

bool integer_word(string text, nat digits := 9)
    return #text >= 1 and #text <= digits and all_chars(text, "0123456789") and (#text == 1 or text[0] != "0")

int | error parse_ipv4(string text)
    parts := text.split(".")
    if #parts != 4
        return error("bad address {text}")
    result := 0
    for part := parts[]
        if not integer_word(part, 3)
            return error("bad address {text}")
        n := int(part)
        if n > 255
            return error("bad address {text}")
        result = result * 256 + n
    return result

string ipv4_text(int value)
    return "{value / 16777216}.{value / 65536 % 256}.{value / 256 % 256}.{value % 256}"

int[] | none parse_groups(string text)
    int[] result := []
    if text == ""
        return result
    for part := text.split(":")[]
        if #part < 1 or #part > 4 or not all_chars(part, "0123456789abcdefABCDEF")
            return none
        value := 0
        for: i < #part
            value = value * 16 + int(find_at("0123456789abcdef", lower(part[i])))
        result = result.append(value)
    return result

int[] | error parse_ipv6(string text)
    split := find_at(text, "::")
    if split == #text
        match parse_groups(text)
            int[] result
                if #result == 8
                    return result
            none
                void
    else
        match parse_groups(text[:<split])
            int[] front
                match parse_groups(text[split + 2:])
                    int[] back
                        if #front + #back <= 7
                            result := front
                            for: i < 8 - #front - #back
                                result = result.append(0)
                            return result.concat(back)
                    none
                        void
            none
                void
    return error("bad address {text}")

string hexadecimal(int value, nat width := 0)
    hex := if value > 0 then value.b16 else "0"
    return if #hex < width then "0" * (width - #hex) + hex else hex

string ipv6_text(int[] groups)
    nat best := 8
    nat width := 1
    nat at := 0
    while at < 8
        end := at
        while end < 8 and groups[end] == 0
            end += 1
        if end - at > width
            best = at
            width = end - at
        at = if end > at then end else at + 1
    parts := [for item := groups[] then hexadecimal(item)]
    return if best == 8 then parts.join(":") else parts[:<best].join(":") + "::" + parts[best + width:].join(":")

string[] labels(string text)
    return if text == "." then [] else text[:<#text - 1].split(".")

string | error parse_name(string text, wildcard := false, origin := "")
    if origin != "" and text == "@"
        return origin
    if text == "."
        return "."
    absolute := text.ends_with(".")
    parts := (if absolute then text[:<#text - 1] else text).split(".")
    for: part := parts[i]
        if wildcard and i == 0 and part == "*"
            continue
        if #part < 1 or #part > 63 or not all_chars(part, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-") or part[0] == "-" or part[#part - 1] == "-"
            return error("bad name {text}")
    result := lower(parts.join(".")) + "."
    return if origin != "" and origin != "." and not absolute then result + origin else result

bool below(string text, string ancestor)
    return ancestor == "." or text == ancestor or text.ends_with("." + ancestor)

string[] ancestors(string text)
    parts := labels(text)
    string[] result := []
    for: i <= #parts
        result = result.append(if i == #parts then "." else parts[i:].join(".") + ".")
    return result

bool name_less(string a, string b)
    first := labels(a)
    second := labels(b)
    n := if #first < #second then #first else #second
    for: i < n
        x := first[#first - i - 1]
        y := second[#second - i - 1]
        if x != y
            return text_less(x, y)
    return #first < #second

string[] names_sorted(string[] names)
    result := names
    for: 1 <= i < #result
        j := i
        while j > 0 and name_less(result[j], result[j - 1])
            held := result[j]
            result[j] = result[j - 1]
            result[j - 1] = held
            j -= 1
    return result

int | error parse_ttl(string text)
    total := 0
    if integer_word(text)
        total = int(text)
    else
        nat at := 0
        previous := -1
        while at < #text
            start := at
            while at < #text and "0123456789".contains(text[at])
                at += 1
            digits := text[start:<at]
            if not integer_word(digits, 3) or at == #text
                return error("bad ttl {text}")
            unit := find_at("wdhms", lower(text[at]))
            if unit == 5 or int(unit) <= previous
                return error("bad ttl {text}")
            previous = int(unit)
            total += int(digits) * [604800, 86400, 3600, 60, 1][unit]
            at += 1
    return if total < 1 or total > 604800 then error("bad ttl {text}") else total

nat type_index(string text)
    types := ["A", "NS", "CNAME", "SOA", "PTR", "MX", "TXT", "AAAA"]
    for: item := types[i]
        if item == text
            return i
    return 8

void | error require_type(string text)
    if type_index(text) == 8
        return error("bad type {text}")
    return void

class Record(string owner, int ttl, string kind)
    data := ""
    target := ""
    number := 0
    int[] groups := []
    minimum := 0

Record | error parse_record(string owner, int ttl, string kind, string[] fields, string origin)
    result := Record(owner, ttl, kind)
    if kind == "A"
        result.number = try parse_ipv4(fields[0])
        result.data = ipv4_text(result.number)
    elif kind == "AAAA"
        result.groups = try parse_ipv6(fields[0])
        result.data = ipv6_text(result.groups)
    elif kind == "NS" or kind == "CNAME" or kind == "PTR"
        result.target = try parse_name(fields[0], false, origin)
        result.data = result.target
    elif kind == "MX"
        if not integer_word(fields[0]) or int(fields[0]) > 65535
            return error("bad preference {fields[0]}")
        result.number = int(fields[0])
        result.target = try parse_name(fields[1], false, origin)
        result.data = "{result.number} {result.target}"
    elif kind == "TXT"
        result.data = fields.join(" ")
        if #result.data < 2 or result.data[0] != DQ or result.data[#result.data - 1] != DQ or result.data[1:<#result.data - 1].contains(DQ)
            return error("bad text {result.data}")
    else
        first := try parse_name(fields[0], false, origin)
        second := try parse_name(fields[1], false, origin)
        parts := [first, second]
        for: 2 <= nat i < 6
            if not integer_word(fields[i])
                return error("bad number {fields[i]}")
            parts = parts.append("{int(fields[i])}")
        if not integer_word(fields[6]) or int(fields[6]) < 1 or int(fields[6]) > 86400
            return error("bad minimum {fields[6]}")
        result.minimum = int(fields[6])
        parts = parts.append("{result.minimum}")
        result.data = parts.join(" ")
    return result

string record_text(Record record)
    return "{record.owner} {record.ttl} {record.kind} {record.data}"

bool data_less(Record a, Record b)
    if a.kind == "A"
        return a.number < b.number
    if a.kind == "AAAA"
        for: nat i < 8
            if a.groups[i] != b.groups[i]
                return a.groups[i] < b.groups[i]
        return false
    if a.kind == "NS" or a.kind == "CNAME" or a.kind == "PTR"
        return name_less(a.target, b.target)
    if a.kind == "MX"
        return if a.number != b.number then a.number < b.number else name_less(a.target, b.target)
    return text_less(a.data, b.data)

bool record_less(Record a, Record b, data_only := false)
    if not data_only
        if a.owner != b.owner
            return name_less(a.owner, b.owner)
        if a.kind != b.kind
            return type_index(a.kind) < type_index(b.kind)
    return data_less(a, b)

Record[] records_sorted(Record[] records, data_only := true)
    result := records
    for: 1 <= i < #result
        j := i
        while j > 0 and record_less(result[j], result[j - 1], data_only)
            held := result[j]
            result[j] = result[j - 1]
            result[j - 1] = held
            j -= 1
    return result

class Zone(string origin, int server, nat line)
    Record[] records := []

Record[] at_owner(Zone zone, string name, kind := "")
    result := [for item := zone.records[] if item.owner == name and (kind == "" or item.kind == kind) then item]
    return if kind == "" then result else records_sorted(result)

bool exists(Zone zone, string name)
    for item := zone.records[]
        if below(item.owner, name)
            return true
    return false

Record soa(Zone zone)
    for item := zone.records[]
        if item.kind == "SOA"
            return item
    return Record(".", 0, "SOA")

class Response(string kind)
    Record[] answer := []
    Record[] authority := []
    Record[] additional := []
    referral := "."

string response_text(Response response)
    return if response.kind == "REFERRAL" then "REFERRAL {response.referral}" elif response.kind == "CNAME" then "CNAME {response.answer[0].target}" else response.kind

class Entry(string name, string kind, string status, Record[] records, int expiry)
class Pair(string name, string kind)
class Resolution(string status, Record[] answer)
class QueryCount(int address)
    counts := array(7, fill = 0)

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

void trace(nat depth, string text)
    emit(" " * ((depth + 1) * 2) + text)

class Resolver()
    int[] roots := []
    Zone[] zones := []
    current := -1
    int[] down := []
    clock := 0
    Entry[] cache := []
    minttl := 1
    maxttl := 86400
    negttl := 3600
    QueryCount[] queries := []
    hits := 0
    resolutions := array(4, fill = 0)

    void | error .zone_input(string text, nat line)
        words := text.split(" ")
        if words[0] == "ROOT"
            int[] addresses := []
            for word := words[1:][]
                address := try parse_ipv4(word)
                if has_number(roots, address) or has_number(addresses, address)
                    return error("duplicate root {word}")
                addresses = addresses.append(address)
            roots = roots.concat(addresses)
        elif words[0] == "ZONE"
            current = -1
            origin := try parse_name(words[1])
            address := try parse_ipv4(words[2])
            for zone := zones[]
                if zone.origin == origin and zone.server == address
                    return error("duplicate zone {origin} at {words[2]}")
            current = int(#zones)
            zones = zones.append(Zone(origin, address, line))
        else
            if current < 0
                return error("no current zone")
            zone := zones[current]
            owner := try parse_name(words[0], true, zone.origin)
            if not below(owner, zone.origin)
                return error("out of zone {owner}")
            ttl := try parse_ttl(words[1])
            kind := words[2]
            try require_type(kind)
            required := if kind == "TXT" then #words - 3 elif kind == "MX" then 2 elif kind == "SOA" then 7 else 1
            if #words - 3 != required
                return error("wrong field count")
            record := try parse_record(owner, ttl, kind, words[3:], zone.origin)
            if kind == "NS" and owner.starts_with("*.")
                return error("ns at wildcard")
            if kind == "SOA" and owner != zone.origin
                return error("soa not at origin")
            if kind == "SOA" and soa(zone).ttl != 0
                return error("duplicate soa")
            for other := zone.records[]
                if other.owner == owner and other.kind == kind and other.data == record.data
                    return error("duplicate record")
            for other := zone.records[]
                if other.owner == owner and (other.kind == "CNAME" or kind == "CNAME")
                    return error("cname conflict {owner}")
            zones[current].records = zones[current].records.append(record)
        return void

    void .finish_zones()
        Zone[] kept := []
        nat total := 0
        for zone := zones[]
            label := "zone {zone.origin} at {ipv4_text(zone.server)}"
            if soa(zone).ttl == 0
                emit("error line {zone.line}: {label} has no soa")
            else
                emit("{label} records={#zone.records}")
                kept = kept.append(zone)
                total += #zone.records
        zones = kept
        emit("loaded roots={#roots} zones={#zones} records={total}")

    bool reachable(int address)
        if has_number(down, address)
            return false
        for zone := zones[]
            if zone.server == address
                return true
        return false

    Response respond(int address, string name, string kind, string cut)
        if not reachable(address)
            return Response("TIMEOUT")
        chosen := -1
        for: zone := zones[i]
            if zone.server == address and below(name, zone.origin) and (chosen < 0 or #labels(zone.origin) > #labels(zones[chosen].origin))
                chosen = int(i)
        if chosen < 0 or #labels(zones[chosen].origin) < #labels(cut)
            return Response("LAME")
        zone := zones[chosen]
        parts := labels(name)
        for: #labels(zone.origin) + 1 <= width <= #parts
            point := parts[#parts - width:].join(".") + "."
            ns := at_owner(zone, point, "NS")
            if #ns > 0
                result := Response("REFERRAL")
                result.authority = ns
                result.referral = point
                for server := ns[]
                    result.additional = result.additional.concat(at_owner(zone, server.target, "A"))
                return result
        records := at_owner(zone, name)
        status := "NODATA"
        if #records == 0 and not exists(zone, name)
            parents := ancestors(name)
            for parent := parents[1:][]
                if exists(zone, parent)
                    records = at_owner(zone, if parent == "." then "*." else "*." + parent)
                    break
            if #records == 0
                status = "NXDOMAIN"
        Record[] matching := []
        Record[] cnames := []
        for record := records[]
            record.owner = name
            if record.kind == kind
                matching = matching.append(record)
            if record.kind == "CNAME"
                cnames = cnames.append(record)
        if #matching > 0 or (kind != "CNAME" and #cnames > 0)
            result := Response(if #matching > 0 then "ANSWER" else "CNAME")
            result.answer = if #matching > 0 then records_sorted(matching) else cnames
            return result
        result := Response(status)
        result.authority = [soa(zone)]
        return result

    Response .ask(int address, string name, string kind, string cut)
        Response result := respond(address, name, kind, cut)
        chosen := #queries
        for: count := queries[i]
            if count.address == address
                chosen = i
                break
        if chosen == #queries
            queries = queries.append(QueryCount(address))
        kinds := ["ANSWER", "CNAME", "REFERRAL", "NODATA", "NXDOMAIN", "LAME", "TIMEOUT"]
        for: item := kinds[i]
            if item == result.kind
                queries[chosen].counts[i] += 1
        return result

    int entry_index(string name, string kind, positive := false)
        for: entry := cache[i]
            if entry.name == name and entry.kind == kind and (not positive or entry.status == "POS")
                return int(i)
        return -1

    void .store(Entry entry)
        int at := entry_index(entry.name, entry.kind)
        if at < 0
            cache = cache.append(entry)
        else
            cache[at] = entry

    int .store_positive(Record[] records)
        ttl := records[0].ttl
        for record := records[]
            if record.ttl < ttl
                ttl = record.ttl
        if ttl < minttl
            ttl = minttl
        if ttl > maxttl
            ttl = maxttl
        .store(Entry(records[0].owner, records[0].kind, "POS", records_sorted(records), clock + ttl))
        return ttl

    Record[] aged(Entry entry)
        result := entry.records
        for: i < #result
            result[i].ttl = entry.expiry - clock
        return result

    Response | none .try_addresses(int[] addresses, string name, string kind, string cut, nat depth)
        for address := addresses[]
            Response result := .ask(address, name, kind, cut)
            trace(depth, "ASK {ipv4_text(address)} {name} {kind} -> {response_text(result)}")
            if result.kind != "LAME" and result.kind != "TIMEOUT"
                return result
        return none

    Response .lookup(string name, string kind, nat depth, Pair[] pending)
        int direct := entry_index(name, kind)
        cached := Response("")
        if direct >= 0
            entry := cache[direct]
            cached.kind = if entry.status == "POS" then "ANSWER" else entry.status
            if entry.status == "POS"
                cached.answer = aged(entry)
        else
            for entry := cache[]
                if entry.status == "NXDOMAIN" and below(name, entry.name)
                    cached.kind = "NXDOMAIN"
                    break
            int cname := entry_index(name, "CNAME", true)
            if cached.kind == "" and kind != "CNAME" and cname >= 0
                cached.kind = "CNAME"
                cached.answer = aged(cache[cname])
        if cached.kind != ""
            hits += 1
            trace(depth, "CACHE HIT {name} {kind} -> {response_text(cached)}")
            return cached
        cut := "."
        string[] servers := []
        hints := true
        for ancestor := ancestors(name)[]
            int at := entry_index(ancestor, "NS", true)
            if at >= 0
                hits += 1
                trace(depth, "CACHE HIT {name} {kind} -> REFERRAL {ancestor}")
                cut = ancestor
                servers = [for record := cache[at].records[] then record.target]
                hints = false
                break
        while true
            Response | none obtained := none
            if hints
                obtained = .try_addresses(roots, name, kind, cut, depth)
            else
                for host := names_sorted(servers)[]
                    int[] addresses := []
                    int at := entry_index(host, "A", true)
                    if at >= 0
                        for record := cache[at].records[]
                            if not has_number(addresses, record.number)
                                addresses = addresses.append(record.number)
                    else
                        loop := false
                        for pair := pending[]
                            if pair.name == host and pair.kind == "A"
                                loop = true
                        if loop
                            trace(depth, "GLUELESS {host} -> LOOP")
                        else
                            trace(depth, "GLUELESS {host}")
                            Resolution found := .resolve(host, "A", depth + 1, pending)
                            if found.status == "NOERROR"
                                for record := found.answer[]
                                    if record.kind == "A" and not has_number(addresses, record.number)
                                        addresses = addresses.append(record.number)
                    obtained = .try_addresses(addresses.sorted(), name, kind, cut, depth)
                    match obtained
                        Response found
                            break
                        none
                            void
            match obtained
                none
                    return Response("SERVFAIL no server for {cut}")
                Response response
                    if response.kind == "REFERRAL"
                        int ttl := .store_positive(response.authority)
                        string[] owners := []
                        for record := response.additional[]
                            if not has_word(owners, record.owner)
                                owners = owners.append(record.owner)
                        for owner := owners[]
                            glue := [for record := response.additional[] if record.owner == owner then record]
                            int stored := .store_positive(glue)
                        cut = response.referral
                        servers = [for record := response.authority[] then record.target]
                        hints = false
                    elif response.kind == "ANSWER" or response.kind == "CNAME"
                        int ttl := .store_positive(response.answer)
                        for: i < #response.answer
                            response.answer[i].ttl = ttl
                        return response
                    else
                        authority := response.authority[0]
                        ttl := authority.ttl
                        if authority.minimum < ttl
                            ttl = authority.minimum
                        if negttl < ttl
                            ttl = negttl
                        .store(Entry(name, kind, response.kind, [], clock + ttl))
                        return Response(response.kind)

    Resolution .resolve(string name, string kind, nat depth := 0, Pair[] pending := [])
        active := pending.append(Pair(name, kind))
        Record[] chain := []
        seen := [name]
        current_name := name
        response := Response("")
        while true
            response = .lookup(current_name, kind, depth, active)
            if response.kind != "CNAME"
                break
            chain = chain.concat(response.answer)
            target := response.answer[0].target
            if has_word(seen, target)
                response = Response("SERVFAIL cname loop")
                break
            if #chain == 9
                response = Response("SERVFAIL cname chain too long")
                break
            seen = seen.append(target)
            current_name = target
        status := if response.kind == "ANSWER" then "NOERROR" else response.kind
        Record[] answer := if status.starts_with("SERVFAIL") then [] else chain.concat(response.answer)
        statuses := ["NOERROR", "NODATA", "NXDOMAIN", "SERVFAIL"]
        for: item := statuses[i]
            if item == status or (item == "SERVFAIL" and status.starts_with("SERVFAIL"))
                resolutions[i] += 1
        return Resolution(status, answer)

    Resolution .report(string name, string kind)
        Resolution result := .resolve(name, kind)
        for record := result.answer[]
            emit("answer " + record_text(record))
        emit("status {result.status}")
        return result

    string .address_resolution(string host)
        string[] addresses := []
        for kind := ["A", "AAAA"][]
            Resolution result := .resolve(host, kind)
            if result.status == "NOERROR"
                for record := result.answer[]
                    if record.kind == kind
                        addresses = addresses.append(record.data)
        return if #addresses == 0 then "no address" else addresses.join(" ")

    void | error .execute(string text)
        words := text.split(" ")
        command := words[0]
        if command == "RESOLVE" or command == "MX"
            name := try parse_name(words[1], true)
            kind := if command == "MX" then "MX" else words[2]
            try require_type(kind)
            emit(if command == "MX" then "mx {name}" else "resolve {name} {kind}")
            Resolution result := .report(name, kind)
            if command == "MX"
                if result.status == "NOERROR"
                    for record := result.answer[]
                        if record.kind == "MX"
                            string addresses := if record.target == "." then "null" else .address_resolution(record.target)
                            emit("exchange {record.number} {record.target} -> {addresses}")
                elif result.status == "NODATA"
                    host := if #result.answer == 0 then name else result.answer[-1].target
                    string addresses := .address_resolution(host)
                    emit("implicit {host} -> {addresses}")
        elif command == "REVERSE"
            address := ""
            string[] parts := []
            suffix := "in-addr.arpa."
            if words[1].contains(":")
                groups := try parse_ipv6(words[1])
                address = ipv6_text(groups)
                digits := [for group := groups[] then hexadecimal(group, 4)].join("")
                for: #digits > i >= 0
                    parts = parts.append(digits[i])
                suffix = "ip6.arpa."
            else
                value := try parse_ipv4(words[1])
                address = ipv4_text(value)
                fields := address.split(".")
                for: 4 > nat i >= 0
                    parts = parts.append(fields[i])
            name := parts.join(".") + "." + suffix
            emit("reverse {address} {name}")
            Resolution result := .report(name, "PTR")
        elif command == "QUERY"
            address := try parse_ipv4(words[1])
            name := try parse_name(words[2], true)
            try require_type(words[3])
            Response result := .ask(address, name, words[3], ".")
            emit("query {ipv4_text(address)} {name} {words[3]} -> {response_text(result)}")
            for record := result.answer[]
                emit("answer " + record_text(record))
            for record := result.authority[]
                emit("authority " + record_text(record))
            for record := result.additional[]
                emit("additional " + record_text(record))
        elif command == "DUMP"
            address := try parse_ipv4(words[1])
            name := try parse_name(words[2])
            prefix := "dump {ipv4_text(address)} {name}"
            if not reachable(address)
                emit("{prefix} -> TIMEOUT")
            else
                chosen := -1
                for: zone := zones[i]
                    if zone.server == address and zone.origin == name
                        chosen = int(i)
                if chosen < 0
                    emit("{prefix} -> REFUSED")
                else
                    emit("{prefix} records={#zones[chosen].records}")
                    for record := records_sorted(zones[chosen].records, false)[]
                        emit("  " + record_text(record))
        elif command == "DOWN" or command == "UP"
            address := try parse_ipv4(words[1])
            present := has_number(down, address)
            if command == "DOWN" and present
                return error("server {words[1]} already down")
            if command == "UP" and not present
                return error("server {words[1]} not down")
            down = if command == "DOWN" then down.append(address) else [for item := down[] if item != address then item]
            emit("{lower(command)} {ipv4_text(address)}")
        elif command == "SET"
            key := words[1]
            if not has_word(["MINTTL", "MAXTTL", "NEGTTL"], key)
                return error("bad setting {key}")
            if not integer_word(words[2]) or int(words[2]) < 1 or int(words[2]) > 604800
                return error("bad value {words[2]}")
            value := int(words[2])
            if (key == "MINTTL" and value > maxttl) or (key == "MAXTTL" and value < minttl)
                return error("minttl above maxttl")
            if key == "MINTTL"
                minttl = value
            elif key == "MAXTTL"
                maxttl = value
            else
                negttl = value
            emit("set {key}={value}")
        elif command == "TIME"
            if not integer_word(words[1]) or int(words[1]) < 1 or int(words[1]) > 1000000
                return error("bad time {words[1]}")
            clock += int(words[1])
            before := #cache
            cache = [for entry := cache[] if entry.expiry > clock then entry]
            emit("time now={clock} expired={before - #cache}")
        elif command == "CACHE" or command == "FLUSH"
            name := if #words == 1 then "." else try parse_name(words[1])
            selected := [for entry := cache[] if below(entry.name, name) then entry]
            if command == "FLUSH"
                cache = [for entry := cache[] if not below(entry.name, name) then entry]
                emit("flush removed={#selected}")
            else
                for: 1 <= i < #selected
                    j := i
                    while j > 0 and (name_less(selected[j].name, selected[j - 1].name) or (selected[j].name == selected[j - 1].name and type_index(selected[j].kind) < type_index(selected[j - 1].kind)))
                        held := selected[j]
                        selected[j] = selected[j - 1]
                        selected[j - 1] = held
                        j -= 1
                emit("cache entries={#selected}")
                for entry := selected[]
                    if entry.status == "POS"
                        for record := aged(entry)[]
                            emit("  " + record_text(record))
                    else
                        emit("  {entry.name} {entry.expiry - clock} {entry.kind} {entry.status}")
        else
            total := 0
            addresses := [for query := queries[] then query.address]
            for query := queries[]
                for count := query.counts[]
                    total += count
            emit("stats queries={total} hits={hits}")
            kinds := ["answer", "cname", "referral", "nodata", "nxdomain", "lame", "timeout"]
            for address := addresses.sorted()[]
                for query := queries[]
                    if query.address == address
                        sent := 0
                        string[] details := []
                        for: count := query.counts[i]
                            sent += count
                            details = details.append("{kinds[i]}={count}")
                        emit("  {ipv4_text(address)} sent={sent} {details.join(" ")}")
            emit("resolutions noerror={resolutions[0]} nodata={resolutions[1]} nxdomain={resolutions[2]} servfail={resolutions[3]}")
        return void

resolver := Resolver()
zone_section := true
nat line_number := 0
while true
    string line
    scan(&line)
    line_number += 1
    if zone_section and line == "END ZONES"
        .resolver.finish_zones()
        zone_section = false
        continue
    if not zone_section and line == "END"
        break
    if zone_section
        match .resolver.zone_input(line, line_number)
            void
                void
            error problem
                emit("error line {line_number}: {problem.message}")
    else
        match .resolver.execute(line)
            void
                void
            error problem
                emit("error line {line_number}: {problem.message}")
